name: Venus Core Pool
rootCause: Venus Core Pool on zkSync Era suffered a $902,000 loss on March 29, 2025, due to a donation attack exploiting a lack of first-depositor protection in a freshly deployed lending market using ERC-4626 shares. The Venus zkSync Era Core Pool listing allowed unprotected external token donations in an ERC-4626-based market without virtual initial liquidity or a first-depositor guard. This let the attacker manipulate share pricing and drain protocol assets.
